summary: Iteration 2 verified (a) new Command Palette and (b) real AI chat streaming after LLM key funding. Backend pytest: 6/6 pass including new test_chat_stream_real_ai_response which asserts non-empty streamed content + done event. Frontend: login->/dashboard; header search button (open-command-palette) opens palette; Ctrl+K opens palette; all 15 items present (5 AI Quick Actions + 10 Navigation) with correct testids; typing 'propos' filters correctly (nav-clients hidden, nav-proposals + ai-create-proposal visible); cmd-nav-clients closes palette and navigates to /clients; cmd-ai-write-follow-up-email shows sonner toast ('AI action: Write follow-up email / Routing to your AI workspace…') and navigates to /ai-chat. AI Chat: chat-input + chat-send returns REAL streamed multi-token content (verified with 'Give me 3 productivity tips' -> 61+ chars, and suggestion click -> 238 char cold-email draft). AI Agents page loads 4 agents from /api/agents and chat-agent-writer navigates to /ai-chat.

issues: Radix DialogContent a11y warnings in console: missing DialogTitle and Description/aria-describedby. Wrap a hidden DialogTitle/Description (or use VisuallyHidden) inside CommandDialog for screen-reader support. Non-blocking but pollutes console.

action_items: OPTIONAL a11y polish: add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle/Description inside CommandDialog to silence Radix console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: CommandPalette.jsx: Ctrl/Cmd+K listener does not check if user is typing in an input elsewhere. Fine for this app (no other Ctrl+K users) but consider guarding e.target.tagName to avoid shadowing browser search on non-app pages if reused.
AIChat.jsx: on catch, replaces the last assistant bubble with a generic error. If the stream partially arrived before the error, that content is lost. Minor.
AIChat.jsx: JSON.parse(line.slice(6)) can throw on malformed SSE line and would break the whole stream loop. Consider try/catch per line.
Command palette runAi always toasts + navigates; consider prefilling the AI Chat with the prompt via query param so users don't have to retype (currently agent is passed but prompt is not).
seed_data_creation: None. Chat messages persisted for sessions TEST_real_ai_session / TEST_session_pytest via pytest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: LLM key is funded and real streaming works. If future tests assert AI text length, use >=10 chars OR check for absence of 'Sorry, something went wrong' — do not use >30 as small prompts produce short replies (e.g. 'Hi'). Command palette Ctrl+K is on document keydown; ensure focus is on body/document (not inside a Radix dialog that was just Escape-closed) — a small wait before pressing helps. cmdk filter uses the item 'value' prop (e.g. 'ai Create proposal', 'go Clients'), so 'propos' matches both AI proposal item and nav-proposals; 'clients' only matches nav-clients (and 'ai research a client'). No auth. All backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py.
